package: Wanderful App Store Release Package V1

blockers.title: Onboarding integration and exact data-flow report reconciled

blockers.title: Public support URL and contact are missing
blockers.dependency: real monitored contact and HTTPS page
evidence: production support URL and contact are UNKNOWN

evidence: tracked production URL exists

blockers.title: Stage B complete suite, builds, runtime QA and artifact inspection are storage-blocked
blockers.dependency: safe storage above the 10,485,760 KiB floor for the complete bounded run and exclusive Xcode ownership
evidence: two Stage B preflight readings passed at 13,358,044 and 13,356,200 KiB
focused Stage B suite passed 395 tests with zero failures/skips in 173.3 seconds
free space fell to 8,008,952 KiB and the run stopped; closed task test artifacts and the one DerivedData directory were removed after handle checks
last settled reading was 12,147,512 KiB, below the 12 GiB restart threshold
complete suite, Debug/Release builds, runtime QA and built-artifact inspection were not run
blockers.acceptance_criterion: Focused and practical complete non-live tests, Debug/Release builds and the critical/error paths pass on the authorized iPhone 17 Pro Simulator with bounded DerivedData.

blockers.title: Embedded SDK privacy manifests and signatures are uninspected
blockers.dependency: built Release app after ASV1-012 storage recovery
evidence: first-party source manifest exists
Package.resolved includes Superwall 4.16.1 and Supabase 2.55.1
no release-lane built combined privacy report exists
blockers.acceptance_criterion: Selected build's app/framework manifests, required-reason APIs, signatures and combined privacy report are inspected and reconciled.

evidence: one universal 1024x1024 source PNG exists
